scope: Read-only source and existing test assertion inspection; no tests executed in this review
accepted_claim: Exact Claimed receipt may be finalized while runtime payment is deferred. Existing signed claim reconciliation authenticates acceptance, not ClaimPaid.
payment: ClaimPaid follows successful nested exact-delta transfer; amount is total accumulated coldkey credit, not necessarily current claim amount.
attribution: Credit accumulates across operator and epoch claims; pool-specific paid attribution requires complete retained credit history and an explicit allocation rule.
controls_required: successful receipt with Claimed and ClaimPaymentDeferred retains accepted liability but unknown/unpaid transfer
later aggregate ClaimPaid larger than current Claimed must not be attributed in full to every pool
expired entitlement does not erase accepted unpaid credit
missing credit history or closing finality yields unavailable attribution, not zero
